title: When resistance keeps arguing with Hukam after the mind has slipped
issueStatement: The mind wants reality to arrive on self-approved terms. The problem now is not only temptation or pain, but what to do after the slip has already happened.
centralInsight: Guru reframes peace as understanding the command already holding everything. Gurbani keeps repair close to remembrance, humility, and return instead of theatre.
practicalReflection: Peace begins when the mind stops arguing with what already stands inside Hukam. Name one thing already here that you need to stop negotiating with.
actionPrompt: Name one thing already here that you need to stop negotiating with. Choose the next truthful return instead of rehearsing the failure.
